title: External incident schedule and action triage for multi-region capacity blip
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidate customer-facing timeline and RCA actions for the 2025-02-18 multi-region capacity degradation. Produce a single canonical external communication, update statuspage entries, and create actionable engineering tickets with owners and SLAs for mitigation and recurrence prevention.
timeline: 2025-02-18 03:12 UTC - First customer reports of increased latencies in EU-West and us-east; internal alerts triggered for autoscaler anomalies.
2025-02-18 03:20 UTC - Autoscaler queue backlog observed; rapid allocation failed due to quota exhaustion on preemptible pools in region eu-west-1.
2025-02-18 03:45 UTC - Failover to warm reserved pool initiated; partial relief for burst traffic but sustained tail latency remained elevated.
2025-02-18 05:10 UTC - Engineering triage concluded fallback routing policy did not trigger for some customers due to policy mismatch introduced in runtime-1.17 rollout.
2025-02-18 06:30 UTC - Temporary mitigation: emergency runway bump for Dedicated tenants + manual model-variant routing applied for highest tier customers.
2025-02-18 12:00 UTC - Incident declared resolved for majority of customers; continued follow-up for residual cache priming and autoscaler configuration.
action_items: A: Draft canonical external status update and customer outreach email (owner: Emily Zhang) - due 2025-02-21 - status: in progress
B: Publish statuspage entry with timeline and mitigation note (owner: Jordan Kim) - due 2025-02-21 - status: done (draft live)
C: Create engineering sub-tickets for autoscaler regression analysis (owner: Liam O'Connor) - due 2025-02-28 - status: in progress - see ENG-50113
D: Add automated smoke tests for fallback-routing policies to CI (owner: Marcos Alvarez) - due 2025-03-05 - status: todo
E: Evaluate reserved pool sizing and burst policy defaults; propose quota increases for preemptible pools (owner: Aisha Patel) - due 2025-03-12 - status: in progress
F: Customer impact matrix and targeted outreach list to be compiled for CSM handoff (owner: Priya Desai) - due 2025-02-24 - status: done
G: Postmortem write-up and annotated runbook updates for on-call (owner: Liam O'Connor) - due 2025-03-01 - status: in progress
comments: 2025-02-20 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting with Eng, PM, and Support. Agreed on single-source external comms and a prioritized action list focused on autoscaler + routing. Action items A, B, F assigned.
2025-02-21 - Emily Zhang: Draft shared (link below). Feedback from PM: remove speculative root cause language; focus on observed facts and next steps. Updated email template attached to 'links'.

2025-02-22 - Liam O'Connor: Initial autoscaler regression repro steps captured. Suspected changeet in runtime-1.17 that altered backlog window calculation. Creating ENG-50113 for deep-dive. Noted intermittent KV-cache warmup added noise to latency metrics.
2025-02-24 - Marcos Alvarez: CI test skeleton for fallback routing added to internal repo; needs validation against synthetic traffic. Will pair with on-call engineer during Cycle 2025-W08.
2025-03-03 - Jordan Kim: Statuspage updated with final timeline and mitigation note. Legal/Trust reviewed external message. Draft customer email sent to CSMs for review before wide send.
2025-03-05 - Priya Desai: CSM outreach completed for 18 tier-1 customers; three requested follow-up technical calls. Scheduling those and assigning ENG liaisons.
